name: Tiara of the Deep
summary: Tabetha asks you to bring her the Tiara of the Deep in Dustwallow Marsh. Velratha has taken it, and Tabetha wants it returned.

sections.title: Tabetha's Request
sections.body: Tabetha in Dustwallow Marsh wants the Tiara of the Deep back from Velratha. You are to bring the tiara to her, and she asks whether Velratha has paid for crossing her.

faq.q: Who wants the Tiara of the Deep?
faq.answer: Tabetha wants you to bring her the Tiara of the Deep in Dustwallow Marsh.

faq.q: Where do I take the Tiara of the Deep?
faq.answer: Bring the Tiara of the Deep to Tabetha in Dustwallow Marsh.
Tabetha says Velratha has the Tiara of the Deep.

faq.q: Why is Tabetha angry with Velratha?
faq.answer: Tabetha says Velratha crossed her and took the tiara.

faq.q: What does Tabetha ask when I return?
faq.answer: Tabetha asks whether you have the tiara and whether Velratha has learned the price of crossing her.
